sentences.en: The Rosemont Theatre is a concert hall in Rosemont, Illinois, a suburb of Chicago.

sentences.en: “While I was musing upon these things, my attention was attracted by a pretty little structure, like a well under a cupola.
I thought in a transitory way of the oddness of wells still existing, and then resumed the thread of my speculations.
There were no large buildings towards the top of the hill, and as my walking powers were evidently miraculous, I was presently left alone for the first time.
With a strange sense of freedom and adventure I pushed on up to the crest.

Godalming thinks that it will be well to have horses always in readiness, for when we get the information which we seek there will be no time to lose.
